description: Verifies the Kerr metric in Boyer-Lindquist and Kerr-Schild forms: horizon and ergosphere radii, regime flags, frame dragging, metric inversion, symmetry, signature, the unit determinant of the Kerr-Schild form and the agreement of the analytic connection with eighth-order finite differences.

checks.label: a / M = 0.8 is classified as sub-extremal
the outer horizon equals M + sqrt(M^2 - a^2)
the inner horizon equals M - sqrt(M^2 - a^2)
the ergosphere touches the outer horizon at the pole
the equatorial ergosphere radius equals 2 M
Kerr: the inverse metric times the metric reproduces the identity
Kerr: the metric tensor is symmetric relative to its largest component
Kerr: the metric determinant is negative, which gives a Lorentzian signature
Kerr: the analytic connection is symmetric in its lower indices
Kerr: the analytic connection matches eighth-order finite differences relative to the largest symbol of its row
the off-diagonal time-azimuth component that encodes frame dragging is present and symmetric
the zero-angular-momentum observers co-rotate with the hole
Kerr-Schild: the inverse metric times the metric reproduces the identity
Kerr-Schild: the metric tensor is symmetric relative to its largest component
Kerr-Schild: the metric determinant is negative, which gives a Lorentzian signature
Kerr-Schild: the analytic connection is symmetric in its lower indices
Kerr-Schild: the analytic connection matches eighth-order finite differences relative to the largest symbol of its row
